description: This is a PHP unit test class 'CountryDaoTest' for the 'CountryDao' data access object in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test methods to verify functions for retrieving country and province data, by calling methods like getCountryList(), getProvinceList(), and others, using fixtures for test data.

classes.name: CountryDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for the CountryDao data access object, includes unit tests for country and province fetching methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case environment, creates a new CountryDao instance, and loads fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Verifies that getCountryList() returns the correct list of Country objects with expected properties.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Checks that getProvinceList() retrieves the expected list of Province objects for a given country code.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a country by name, including a case for when the country does not exist.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a country by code, including a case for nonexistent code.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a province by code, including a non-existent case.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a province by name, including a non-existent case.
